Decision written to review/C-dashboard-4/decision.json: PROMOTE.

Evidence: canary 1.1 served 2411 of 9785 requests (~25%) with 0 5xx and 0.00% error rate, identical to stable's 0 5xx over 7374 requests. Latency is at parity overall (canary p50/p95/p99 = 34/93/105 ms vs stable 34/94/104 ms) and per endpoint: /browse 22/27 both, /search 47/59/61 both, /checkout canary 82/104/107 vs stable 81/103/105 ms. The four 30 s windows show no degradation trend and no errors in either arm.

Two items I judged non-blocking (labelled judgement): (1) canary /browse p99 is 77 ms vs stable 28 ms, but /browse p95 is identical at 27 ms, so this is a thin tail of a few requests at an absolute latency lower than the normal /checkout path — not customer-visible. (2) In the 90-120 s window canary p95 is 96 ms vs stable 92 ms, a ~4 ms gap that is within the noise seen across earlier windows and does not form a rising trend.

No error-rate or latency signal justifies blocking the release, so PROMOTE.
